one_line: Maharana of Mewar who negotiated the 1615 peace with the Mughal Empire under Jahangir.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but battle-hardened build, upright and controlled posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, sharp straight nose, medium-brown Rajput complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache with slightly upturned ends, faint worry lines at the brow, calm but guarded eyes; default expression is composed, serious and introspective, as if weighing duty and pride.
appearance.hair: Long black hair gathered neatly at the back in a low knot hidden under a deep saffron-orange cotton pagri wrapped Mewar-style, with a slightly flared front and a narrow white cloth band at the base; a small, simple gold kalgi-like tuft (no large plume) sits slightly off-center, subtly indicating royal status without ostentation.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length white cotton angarkha (wrap-tunic) with a slightly flared skirt and overlapping front panels tied on the right with thin internal ties, finely but simply bordered with a narrow muted-gold line at the cuffs and hem; over this is a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton varq-like coat in a subdued maroon-red, lightly padded and stitched in small diamond patterns, reaching just above the knee; his lower garment is a pair of off-white churidar-style tight-fitting trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; around his waist is a broad mustard-yellow cotton patka (sash) worn over a plain brown leather kamarband, the patka ends hanging on his left side with subtle woven motifs; for armour he wears a dark steel-gray mail-and-plate torso vest peeking from beneath the maroon coat when he moves, with simple rounded steel bracers on his forearms; his feet are in traditional brown leather Rajputi mojari with slightly upturned toes and minimal embroidery; jewelry is restrained: a single medium-width gold armlet on his right upper arm with a tiny green stone, a simple gold signet ring on his right hand, and small gold stud earrings, emphasizing understated royal dignity rather than opulence.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, elegant disc pommel, and a plain brass hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, sheathed in a dark-brown scabbard with a simple brass chape, worn at his left hip through the mustard-yellow patka, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt as a habitual gesture.

ref_desc: Maharana Amar Singh I is a late-30s lean Rajput with medium-brown complexion, oval face and neat upturned moustache, wearing a saffron-orange Mewar pagri, white angarkha, maroon quilted sleeveless coat, off-white churidar, mustard-yellow patka, steel-gray mail accents and brown mojari, carrying a curved Rajput talwar in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Maharana Amar Singh I as a dignified Rajput ruler in 1615: a late-30s, lean, battle-hardened man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp straight nose, and a neatly trimmed black moustache with slightly upturned ends, his expression calm, serious and introspective. His long black hair is tied back in a low knot hidden beneath a deep saffron-orange cotton Mewar-style pagri with a slightly flared front, a narrow white band at its base, and a small, simple gold tuft at the front. He wears a knee-length white cotton angarkha with a gentle flare, overlapping panels tied on the right, and a very thin muted-gold border at cuffs and hem; over this is a sleeveless quilted maroon-red coat, lightly padded, cut just above the knee, stitched in small diamond patterns, and open enough to hint at a dark steel-gray mail-and-plate vest beneath at the torso and simple rounded steel bracers on his forearms. His trousers are off-white churidar, closely fitting and gathered at the ankles, and he wears brown leather Rajputi mojari with slightly upturned toes and minimal decoration. Around his waist is a broad mustard-yellow cotton patka over a plain brown leather belt, its patterned ends hanging on his left side, securing a curved Rajput talwar in a dark-brown scabbard with a simple brass tip; the sword has a steel blade and plain brass hilt with disk pommel and dark brown leather grip, and his right hand often rests lightly on the hilt. Add subtle jewelry only: a single gold armlet with a tiny green stone on his right upper arm, a simple gold signet ring, and small gold stud earrings. Use a restrained palette of white, maroon red, saffron orange, mustard yellow, dark brown and steel gray, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show pagri shape, moustache, layered garments, sash, armour hints and the talwar at his left hip, keeping everything modest, historically grounded and dignified.
